about: Feishu / Lark webhook vectors (P16-14). 'vendor' is the decryption example from the Feishu Open Platform event-encryption documentation; 'url_verification' and 'signature' were made with the openssl command line (AES-256-CBC with key = SHA-256 of the encrypt key, IV = the first 16 bytes of the cipher text; signature = SHA-256 hex of timestamp + nonce + encrypt key + raw body), not with our code.
